description: Runs npm/pnpm/yarn audit and returns structured vulnerability data. Auto-detects package manager via lock files (pnpm-lock.yaml → pnpm, yarn.lock → yarn, otherwise npm).

args.description: Escape-hatch for PM-specific flags not modeled in the schema

fix.description: When true, run `npm audit fix` (or `pnpm audit --fix`) to automatically fix vulnerabilities. Returns counts of fixed and remaining vulnerabilities.

level.description: Minimum severity level to report (maps to --audit-level for npm/pnpm)

omit.description: Dependency groups to omit from the audit (maps to --omit for npm, e.g. ['dev', 'optional'])

packageLockOnly.description: Audit from lockfile without requiring node_modules (maps to --package-lock-only for npm)

packageManager.description: Package manager to use. Auto-detected from lock files if not specified (pnpm-lock.yaml → pnpm, yarn.lock → yarn, otherwise npm).

production.description: Audit only production (runtime) dependencies (maps to --production for npm, --prod for pnpm, --groups=dependencies for yarn)

workspace.description: Workspace to audit (maps to --workspace for npm)

name: audit

packageManager.description: Package manager that was used (npm, pnpm, or yarn)

title: Audit Dependencies
